title: Theft: Consolidation and Grading
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree: $75,000 or more, or property taken by extortion. 3rd degree: over $500 to under $75,000, or a firearm, motor vehicle, vessel, boat, horse, airplane, CDS or certain other items regardless of value. 4th degree: $200 to $500. Disorderly persons: under $200
key_points: All forms of theft in Chapter 20 are a single offense; the charge may be supported by evidence of any of the forms.
Amounts stolen in one scheme or course of conduct may be aggregated.

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: All forms of theft in Chapter 20 are a single offense

subsections.label: b(1)
subsections.text: 2nd degree: $75,000 or more; property taken by extortion; certain CDS amounts; people smuggling and other listed cases

subsections.label: b(2)
subsections.text: 3rd degree: over $500 to under $75,000; or a firearm, motor vehicle, vessel, boat, horse, domestic companion animal, airplane, CDS, blank prescription, or other listed items regardless of value

subsections.label: b(3)
subsections.text: 4th degree: at least $200 but not more than $500

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: Claim of right defenses; amounts in one scheme may be aggregated
